notes: At Home (SFRA). Same access route as Bestsellers/Clearance: Akamai blocks direct HTML (403), Search-UpdateGrid/Search-Refinebar demandware controllers are unchallenged. qty = data-product-count attribute from each category's Search-UpdateGrid grid-footer; cross-checked against Search-Refinebar's rendered 'Show N Items' text for the root and a sample child (root 'new'=4,239 both places). COLLECTION-PAGE TEST: all rows below are real product listings confirmed via Search-UpdateGrid (product tiles + pagination + data-product-count present), not editorial/lookbook pages, so none needed an ambiguous-collection flag. Structure used: the site's primary 'New Arrivals' mega-menu section - root /new/ (4,239) + its 'New Arrivals Shop All' listing (/new-arrivals-shop-all/, 3,687) + the 12 department-level New Arrivals children found under that same menu section; sum of the 12 children (3,601) is a close, plausible near-match to the Shop All total (3,687), consistent with genuine parent/child structure. Included 'Holiday New Arrivals' (/new-seasonal/) since this task is not scoped to home-decor-only categories the way the prior Furniture pass was - it is a genuine site-defined New Arrivals child. DEDUP DECISIONS (excluded from rows, counts recorded for transparency): each individual department's own left-nav subnav additionally links a second, differently-slugged 'New Arrivals'/'New Products' page, separate from the canonical /new-* ones above. These were checked and excluded because most diverge sharply from the canonical count (evidence of stale/orphaned legacy category IDs rather than a second genuine current listing), e.g.: kitchen-dining-new-products=1 (vs canonical new-kitchen-and-dining=321), window-new-arrivals=98 (vs new-curtains-window=650), rugnewarrivals=5 (vs new-rugs=95), patio-garden-new-products=34 (vs new-outdoor=4, and this one is itself larger than its canonical counterpart, reinforcing that these are a separate/inconsistent legacy taxonomy), decor-pillows-new-products=0, faux-new-arrivals=0, new-lower-prices=0. A few of these legacy duplicates were close to the canonical figure (furniture-new-products=34 exactly matches new-furniture=34; wall-decor-new-products=305 vs new-wall-decor=302; storage-cleaning-new-products=367 vs new-storage-and-cleaning=365) and are most likely true aliases of the rows already listed, not separate distinct listings.
